summary: OpenAlex re-identifies works (the old W id 404s and the DOI resolves to a new one), so storing a work must delete any other work with the same DOI (case-insensitive, non-empty only) and its authorship, affiliation and year-count rows in the same transaction; a regen must keep this, and within one batch the work stored last wins.
reason: Refresh stored the new work_id and left the old row forever (foreign keys are off, nothing cascades), so curate returned the same paper twice (55 DOIs on a 127k-work mirror). Works without a DOI are never matched; the lancet_works delete fires the FTS delete trigger so the word-match index stays consistent.
validated_outcome: Tests assert child rows are gone and that curate/search returns the DOI once and no longer matches the old title text.
